description: POST /v2/dedicated-inferences answers 422 `The selected GPU Plan <plan> is currently unavailable in this region, please try again later.` when the region has no capacity for the GPU plan. Type it as GpuPlanUnavailable so a caller can tell capacity from a bad spec; other 422s stay UnprocessableEntity.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The region has no capacity for the GPU plan right now (422 `... is currently unavailable in this region, please try again later.`).

message.includes: is currently unavailable in this region
